messages.content:
Outcome: Depressive symptoms (lower is better)

## Study A
Found: benefit
Claim: Women receiving omega-3 plus vitamin D co-supplementation had a greater reduction in depression than the placebo group.
Sentence: "There was also a significant difference between the group receiving both supplements and the group receiving only placebos in terms of reduction in depression and stress (p < .05)."
Measured as: depression (Depression Anxiety Stress Scale-21)
Population: 168 reproductive-aged women with pre-diabetes and hypovitaminosis D
Intervention: omega-3 (two 1000-mg tablets daily) plus vitamin D (50,000 IU every 2 weeks) for 8 weeks
Comparator: placebo
Design: randomized controlled trial
Sample size: 168
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

## Study B
Found: harm
Claim: In PD patients given vitamin D3, folic acid and B12 for 6 months, the 15D depression dimension score significantly increased (improved) from baseline.
Sentence: "After the intervention, the mean score of speech, mental function, discomfort and symptoms, depression, and QoL significantly increased (p < 0.05 for all)."
Measured as: depression (15D dimension score)
Population: Levodopa-treated Parkinson's disease patients in Romania, mean age 71 years
Intervention: Daily tablet with 800 IU vitamin D3, 1000 µg folic acid, 15 µg vitamin B12 for 6 months
Comparator: None (single-arm, baseline vs 6 months)
Design: case series
Sample size: not reported
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

content.text: {"rationale":"Both studies test vitamin D-containing combination supplements, but Study A is a placebo-controlled RCT in women with pre-diabetes while Study B is an uncontrolled single-arm case series in elderly Parkinson's patients, so the conflicting direction is best explained by the absence of a control group.","verdict":"genuine","reason":"design_or_bias","also_differs":["population","intervention","comparator","outcome_measure"],"detail":"design: placebo-controlled RCT vs single-arm baseline-vs-6-months case series (no control)"}
